fomod.Name: OSF Animation
fomod.Author: ozooma10
fomod.Description: The engine of the OSF scene framework for Starfield: native AF/GLTF/GLB playback, synced multi-actor scenes, anchoring, and a scene-graph runtime. Requires matching SFSE, Address Library, and OSF Settings 1.0.0+. For the in-game browser, wheel, and optional starter content, also install OSF Animation Browser 1.5.0 and OSF UI 2.0.0+. Replace the old Animation installation instead of merging; preserve custom content and saved user data.
